title: Place Your Service
summary: Production AC service management web platform engineering end-to-end service, asset, AMC, technician, inventory, and payment operations with audit logs.

caseStudy.overview: Place Your Service is an internal enterprise operational web platform designed for an air-conditioning sales and service business. It replaces fragmented WhatsApp chats and disconnected Excel spreadsheets with a single, auditable operational workspace.
caseStudy.problem: HVAC service operations suffered from lost technician reports, inventory leakage, untracked AMC (Annual Maintenance Contracts) renewals, and disputed customer invoices. A robust system was required to enforce strict state transitions and provide tamper-proof operational records.
caseStudy.solution: Engineered a dual-platform architecture (Vercel edge frontend + Render backend API) communicating with a Supabase PostgreSQL instance. Implemented role-based access control (Admin, Staff, Field Technician, Customer), automated AMC lifecycle alerts, and live job status dispatching.
caseStudy.role: Lead Full-Stack Engineer — Designed the relational PostgreSQL schema, built the Express REST API endpoints, implemented JWT/RLS access controls, and developed responsive technician & admin dashboard views.

architecture.description: Client SPA -> Vercel Edge CDN -> Render Express API Gateway -> Supabase PostgreSQL Database with Row Level Security (RLS).

tradeoffs.reason: HVAC contracts, technicians, assets, and invoices are inherently relational. Foreign keys and ACID transactions prevented orphaned service records.
Allows independent scaling of background notification workers without blocking instant frontend asset delivery.

codeSnippets.description: Row Level Security policy restricting service ticket mutations to assigned technicians and administrators.

outcomes: Eliminated 100% of untracked technician dispatch calls.
Zero data leakage via strict PostgreSQL RLS policies.
Sub-120ms average API response time on Render.

title: Extreme Sales & Services
summary: Full-stack enterprise HVAC sales, servicing, recurring AMC lifecycle, and real-time dispatch web platform live in production on Vercel and Render.

caseStudy.overview: Extreme Sales & Services (V2.0) is an enterprise commercial platform that automates sales inquiries, equipment installation scheduling, and preventative maintenance for commercial and residential HVAC clients.
caseStudy.problem: Manual quotation handoffs and paper service logs led to 3-week turnaround delays in customer contract renewals and frequent scheduling overlaps across field teams.
caseStudy.solution: Redesigned the entire web architecture into customer-facing portals and private administrative operational consoles. Deployed a high-availability Node.js backend on Render connected to Google Cloud Firestore with health check monitoring.
caseStudy.role: Full-Stack Web Architect — Engineered the responsive user interfaces, built real-time inquiry conversion pipelines, and deployed the production application across Vercel and Render.

architecture.description: Production Frontend on Vercel Global Edge CDN, Render Node.js backend service with live /healthz monitoring, Google Cloud Firestore database.

tradeoffs.reason: Field technicians needed instant alerts when an emergency HVAC dispatch was reassigned, without polling battery drain on mobile devices.

codeSnippets.description: Production health check endpoint verifying database connectivity and memory usage.

outcomes: Live production deployment with 99.9% uptime on Render and Vercel.
Reduced inquiry-to-dispatch turnaround from 48 hours to under 30 minutes.
Seamless mobile responsiveness for technicians working in the field.

title: AI Café
summary: Cinematic AI-driven commerce platform integrating a 192-frame canvas experience, Gemini-powered intent-aware AI Barista V2, and Drink Studio.

caseStudy.overview: AI Café is a next-generation interactive e-commerce platform that reimagines beverage discovery. Instead of standard product grids, customers converse with an intent-aware AI Barista powered by Gemini and customize drinks in a dynamic visual studio.
caseStudy.problem: Traditional e-commerce menus are static, overwhelmed with complex syrup and milk customizations, and provide zero contextual guidance for dietary restrictions or taste preferences.
caseStudy.solution: Built a cinematic WebP frame-by-frame canvas engine (192 frames) coupled with an intent engine distinguishing 12 beverage inquiry intents (budget, pairing, allergies, customization). All catalog queries remain server-authoritative to eliminate hallucinations.
caseStudy.role: Frontend & AI Engineer — Engineered the 192-frame canvas scroll pipeline, built the Gemini AI Barista intent parser, and designed the interactive custom drink studio.

architecture.description: Preloaded 192 WebP frame canvas -> Gemini LLM Intent Parser -> Deterministic Firestore Catalog Query -> Real-Time Cart State.

tradeoffs.chosen: LLM Intent Classifier + Deterministic Catalog Search
tradeoffs.reason: Prevents AI hallucinations where the model invents drinks not in inventory or makes false allergen claims.

tradeoffs.chosen: Preloaded WebP Frame Sequence on Canvas
tradeoffs.reason: Provides pixel-perfect frame scrubbing synchronized with user scroll position without video decode stutter on iOS Safari.

codeSnippets.description: 12-intent classifier mapping natural language prompts to deterministic catalog filters.

outcomes: Buttery 60fps frame scrubbing across desktop and mobile browsers.
Zero hallucinated menu items through strict deterministic catalog binding.

title: Nexa Bank
summary: Full-stack loan management platform built with Express and PostgreSQL, featuring relational SQL migrations, JWT security, loan calculator, and admin portal.

caseStudy.overview: Nexa Bank is a comprehensive loan management web platform engineered to streamline consumer loan applications, credit risk calculations, and administrative approval workflows.
caseStudy.problem: Loan approvals often require complex interest calculations, multi-step documentation reviews, and strict audit trails that manual spreadsheets fail to secure.
caseStudy.solution: Built a structured Express.js backend backed by a relational PostgreSQL database with automated SQL migration scripts (init.sql). Features real-time EMI loan calculator, JWT-protected administrative endpoints, and automated loan lifecycle state management.
caseStudy.role: Full-Stack Backend & Database Engineer — Authored the relational database schema, SQL migration scripts, amortization calculator algorithms, and JWT authentication middleware.

architecture.description: Express.js REST API -> JWT Authentication & Authorization Middleware -> PostgreSQL Relational Database with init.sql schema migrations.

tradeoffs.reason: Guarantees complete control over database constraints, foreign keys, and indexes without hidden ORM overhead or schema corruption.

codeSnippets.description: Relational loan application schema with foreign keys and financial constraints.
codeSnippets.code:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loans (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  amount NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  term_months INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (term_months BETWEEN 6 AND 360),
  interest_rate NUMERIC(5, 2) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'disbursed')),
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

outcomes: 100% auditable loan approval pipeline with database constraint validation.
Automated migration setup script (setup.ps1) for seamless multi-platform deployment.
Instant accurate EMI calculations and amortization schedule breakdown.
